notes: v397 — NEW TRAINING LESSON: "30 · One row, read out loud — a worked example." It takes one real combo row from the 📋 report card and reads every number on it in plain English, the way a teacher would: what 'fired 32×' really means (32 experiments), why 56% is barely better than a coin, what the edge does and doesn't count, the sting hidden in 'wins +9% / losses −12.8%' (each loss hurts more than each win helps), why TOO EARLY caps the score no matter how nice the edge looks (proof before promise), and when a tape count is too small to trust. Ends with the one-breath way to read ANY row — and a 4-question quiz on the traps. Find it in 🎓 Training, lesson 30. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
